title: conversation_suggestion
description: What the suggestion prompt is permitted to return. Three fields: the draft, how sure the model is, and which supplied memories affected it. Nothing else -- a model cannot name a chat, a recipient or an action, because there is no field here to put one in (ADR-061).

suggestion.description: The message the operator could send. Bounded well below what a chat platform accepts: a suggestion longer than this is one nobody will read before sending, which defeats the review it exists for.

confidence.description: Self-reported, and poorly calibrated (AI_MODELS section 15). Used to decide whether a suggestion is offered at all, and nothing more is claimed of it. Bounded here so a value outside the range is caught as a malformed answer rather than compared against a threshold as though it meant something.

used_memory_keys.description: The key of every supplied memory that affected the suggestion. Required, and an empty array is a correct answer: many replies need no stored knowledge at all. Every key is checked against what was actually supplied -- a key that was not is a fabricated attribution, discarded and counted.
